mechanism: Sildenafil causes vasodilation and hypotension while primaquine can cause hemolytic anemia and methemoglobinemia, potentially compounding cardiovascular compromise and tissue oxygenation issues.
action: Monitor blood pressure and oxygen saturation closely; assess hemoglobin/hematocrit before and during primaquine therapy; use sildenafil with caution in patients receiving primaquine, particularly those with G6PD deficiency.
